event.criterion: Resolved on the named data series only: worldwide net trade sales of Spravato (esketamine nasal spray) as stated in Johnson & Johnson's product-sales tables in its periodic reports on SEC EDGAR (Form 10-K and Form 10-Q) and the sales exhibits furnished with its quarterly earnings releases (Form 8-K). TRUE on the date of the first Johnson & Johnson report that shows Spravato worldwide net sales at or above US$1 billion for a calendar year. 'Blockbuster' in the forecaster's words is read as US$1 billion of annual sales, the standard industry meaning, so the event resolves as binary at US$1 billion with no band. FALSE at the deadline when no calendar year completed by then has reached US$1 billion in the reported series. If Johnson & Johnson stops reporting Spravato sales separately and no figure has published 12 months after the deadline, the event is unresolvable. Realized values are stored, not scored.
